task.title: Relics: resolve each linked task once in one update
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M64). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

`workbook relic update --link` costs about four Git processes for each `--link` group (22 processes for one link, 58 for ten). One update with 1,999 groups took 10 minutes on a loaded machine.

## Wanted

Resolve and read each distinct task once per update.

## Done when

- The Git process count of an update grows with the number of distinct tasks, not with the number of links.
- A benchmark scenario pins it.
